svg.title: Volunteer coordinator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as volunteer coordinator, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A volunteer rota with attendance marks sits above an open offering hand. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
